name: Agnes Mure Mackenzie
credit: No confirmed portrait sourced for this archive.
bio: Agnes Mure Mackenzie (1891–1955) was a Scottish historian, novelist and poet, born in Stornoway on the Isle of Lewis, and a writer on Scottish history and literature.
Lyra Celtica (1924) prints her poem 'Aignish on the Machair'.

poems.title: Aignish on the Machair
poems.author: Agnes Mure Mackenzie
poems.text:
When day and night are over,
And the World is done with me,
Oh carry me West and lay me
In Aignish by the Sea.

And never heed me lying
Among the ancient dead,
Beside the white sea breakers
And sand-drift overhead.

The grey gulls wheeling ever,
And the wide arch of sky,
On Aignish on the Machair,
And quiet there to lie.
